title: Tag management audit - www.example-shop.com
subtitle: Fictional example: 3 tools side by side (GTM, Matomo Tag Manager, Tag Commander), sources of different kinds
method_note: Method: static reading of the containers (tags, triggers, blockers, scopes). GTM read from an interface export, Matomo Tag Manager and Tag Commander read from the client code. To be confirmed in the Preview/Debug mode of each tool on the live site.

constats.title: ANOMALY 1: GTM tag 60 (Display network) can never fire
constats.text: The trigger requires cmp_update AND marketing:true. The blocker fires on any event AND marketing:true. When the trigger is true the blocker is true too, and blocking always wins. Check the intent: the blocker was probably meant to test the absence of consent (negated marketing:true), as tag 40 (Meta) does.

constats.title: ANOMALY 2: the Matomo page view is sent twice
constats.text: GTM tag 50 (Custom HTML) and MTM tag 202 both send a page view to the analytics.example.org server, site 1. Only one of the two implementations should remain. Note that only the MTM tag is subject to requireConsent: GTM tag 50 has no consent condition.

constats.title: Meta pixel deployed in two tools
constats.text: Pixel 000000000000000 is loaded by GTM tag 40 (with a consent blocker) and by Tag Commander tags 111 and 132. Without coordination, PageView and Purchase events can be counted twice. Consent on the Tag Commander side cannot be verified from the client code.

constats.title: Leftover tags to clean up
constats.text: GTM 70 (paused), MTM 206 (campaign ended on 2025-12-31) and Tag Commander 140 (defined but never launched) no longer have any effect but weigh down the containers.

constats.title: Tag Commander: scopes to read with care
constats.text: The compiled code puts the scope in front of each tag. When it takes the form expr||(tag), the tag runs if expr is FALSE: tags 122 and 123 are read here the right way round (De Morgan). To be confirmed in the Tag Commander debug mode.

constats.title: Google Consent Mode: mixed implementation
constats.text: The GA4 tags (20 and 21) fire without any consent condition, which matches Advanced if the consent signals are properly updated by the CMP. Google Ads (30) is gated on marketing consent, which matches Basic. Check that no Update tag is needed on the CMP side.
